title: Localize the operational runs panels
description: Extend the existing dependency-free LocaleCatalog with one typed runsOperational section for the four remaining operational panels on /runs: cost by role and model, current-run activity, preserved workspaces, and previous runs. Keep en-US as the only production-selected locale and reuse runInspector state labels and expected-cost wording instead of duplicating them. The new section must cover each panel title and description; executor/reviewer role labels; input/output/cache-read/cache-created token labels and the tokens suffix; optional effort/thinking wording; the activity recent-event count and Tools label; preserved-resource singular/plural and needs/need grammar; previous-run count/newest-first wording; and timestamp formatting through the explicit Locale. Keep model names, effort values, event kinds, event payload text/errors/findings, workspace paths, branches, notice kinds/details, issue ids and every provider/operator/runtime-authored value verbatim. Preserve the current bounded windows, filtering, ordering, cost arithmetic, state tones and disclosure behavior. Thread Locale and the runsOperational subcatalog only through RunCostPanel, RunActivity, WorkspaceNoticesPanel and PreviousRunsPanel; RunsSurface must use the already-cataloged shell route label for its main accessible label. Do not migrate WorkflowInsightsPanel or WorkflowBenchmarkPanel in this slice, and do not translate the shared ContextPanel open/close affordance yet because changing every route would exceed this boundary; pt-BR remains internal and unselectable. Extend the existing static-render tests in place with one explicit pt-BR /runs fixture that exercises all four panels, locale-specific USD and timestamps, token/role labels, activity count/tool label, workspace grammar and previous-run state reuse, while proving authored/raw values remain unchanged. Preserve existing en-US assertions. Do not add snapshots, wording-regex gates, dependencies, endpoints, tables or settings. Update HANDOFF.md only to record the stable post-merge phase: shell, conversation, shared inspector and operational /runs panels internally localized; workflow signals/benchmark, /work, /settings and onboarding remain before any selector. Preserve its resilient header, history and approval boundary. Out of scope: visible locale selection, persistence, browser inference, workflow signals or benchmarks, /work, /settings, onboarding, server/client status messages, notifications, orchestrator prompts, database or lifecycle behavior.
